messages:
elaine_sales: NovaHealth POC - intermittent 504s/502s when Python backend and TS frontend hit our hosted API via their corporate proxy. Demo on Friday, can we triage?
ben_engineering: on it. which SDKs and proxy host? sounds like connection pooling + proxy limits.
elaine_sales: python sdk v0.9.3 (requests), ts sdk v1.1.2. Proxy: proxy.sawtooth.local:8443, they have HTTPS_PROXY set, no NO_PROXY. Fail rate ~7% under mixed load.
priya_support: common. quick mitigations: enable Session pooling + retries in python, enable keepAlive agent in node, and try NO_PROXY to bypass corporate proxy for our endpoints.
ben_engineering: python snippet we recommend:
```
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry
import requests
s = requests.Session()
retries = Retry(total=4, backoff_factor=0.3, status_forcelist=[429,502,503,504])
s.mount('https://', HTTPAdapter(pool_maxsize=80, max_retries=retries, pool_block=True))
# use `s` as transport for Redwood client
```
node snippet:
```
const agent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true, maxSockets: 60 });
const client = new RedwoodClient({ transport: { agent } });
```
ravi_sre: also capture proxy logs for per-IP connection caps and session affinity. If they cannot set NO_PROXY, force pooling and shorter idle timeouts client-side.
secops_bot: privacy note: edge collects source IP for metrics; headers are not persisted by default. For PII-sensitive uses recommend Private deployment + KMS and controlled audit logs.
elaine_sales: customer asked whether Dedicated would help. ben?
ben_engineering: Dedicated reduces noisy neighbors on our side but won't bypass their corporate proxy. Private (VPC or on-prem) removes their proxy from the path. For cost impact we need QPS and token estimates; I can prepare sizing.
priya_support: action items: ben -> share repro script toggling NO_PROXY + connection stats; ravi -> proxy checklist; secops_bot -> send short FAQ; elaine -> ask customer to run repro tonight and share results.
elaine_sales: thanks all, I'll ping when we have run results.
